summary: Iter 26 — Influencer AI Story Image (Gemini Nano Banana, gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview). Backend 4/4 pytest passed: POST /api/influencer/ai/story-image {campaign_id: CLUB-10, estilo:'noite'} -> 200, content-type image/png, ~1.4MB body, PIL-decoded 9:16 portrait (h>w); invalid campaign_id -> 404; partner token -> 403; admin token -> 403; total suite ~13s. Frontend E2E: login influencer.exemplo -> InfluencerDashboard -> coupon-ai-image opens story-image-dialog -> story-style-fresco selected -> story-generate triggers story-skeleton -> story-image rendered within ~90s (naturalWidth=768, naturalHeight=1376, portrait confirmed) -> story-download triggered browser download 'story-CLUB-10.png' -> Escape closes dialog. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_ai.ai_story_image: no rate limiting / cost guard — a rogue influencer could burn LLM tokens generating images repeatedly. Consider per-user cooldown (e.g. 1 image / 15s) or daily quota.
If Gemini returns no image the endpoint raises 502 only when list is empty; consider validating mime_type startswith 'image/' before returning to avoid an unexpected content-type reaching the client.
StoryImageDialog.download: no null-guard on url (button only renders when url set, so safe, but explicit guard would harden against race).
